name: pandoc
checksum_note: Byte size and SHA-256 verified over a local HTTPS download on the owner host and re-verified from the release archive during 013-a; this is an integrity pin, not a GPG signature attestation.
local_debian_note: The owner host also carries Debian pandoc 3.7.0.2+ds-1 at /usr/bin/pandoc; the pin targets the upstream release archive so CI installs an identical byte-verified binary into an owned prefix.
startup_contract: One-time startup check (exact version match, then a positioned-JSON capability probe), then bounded per-request parsing: finite timeout, bounded streaming capture with immediate output cap enforcement, finite node limits, and fail-closed protection on any failure reason.
